farmer

He is mentioned in a letter of Charles Wooldridge to JBY in 1877 as bankrupt and temporarily employed on business, and was probably the Sillence, farmer of New Barn, mentioned as a dealer in carthorses, one of his tenants, by Sir William Heathcote [Awdry, Heathcote 186; Wooldridge outletters]
